about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_map.py). bad replays the map-miss class failure of references/target-class.json: it throws the real File not found line for the missing map path. good lists the folder first, checks the entry exists, reads once only, falls back to an existing file, and prints the listing report it promises.

fixture.notes.md:
# Map notes
list first, check exists, read once.

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/.opencode/repomap.md blind read'
throw 'File not found: owner/name/other/repomap.md guessed path'
pairs.good: $h = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter repomap.md; 'glob check PASS no guess'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md chained across folders'
pairs.good: Get-ChildItem -Name | Select-Object -First 1 | Out-Null; 'single listing PASS stopped'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md blind read no listing'
pairs.good: Test-Path -LiteralPath notes.md | Out-Null; 'list check exist PASS present'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md identical retry hammer'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath notes.md -Raw | Out-Null; 'once stop report PASS listed'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md no report silent'
throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md blind guess'
pairs.good: Get-ChildItem -Name | Out-Null; Get-Content -LiteralPath notes.md -TotalCount 1 | Out-Null; 'list check once PASS read'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md guessed blind'
pairs.good: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.md | ForEach-Object Name | Out-Null; 'glob check PASS found'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md chained silent'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath src/app.md -TotalCount 1 | Out-Null; 'single report PASS done'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md repeated hammer'
pairs.good: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath repomap.md)) { Get-ChildItem -Name | Out-Null; 'once stop PASS missed listed' }

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md guessed hammer'
pairs.good: Get-ChildItem -Name | Out-Null; Get-Content -LiteralPath notes.md -TotalCount 1 | Out-Null; 'fallback list PASS existing'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: owner/name/repomap.md silent repeat'
